name: The Clear Sight
subtitle: Focus Bracelet · Lapis Lazuli & Clear Quartz
promise: Cut the noise. Think one clean thought at a time.
body: Royal-blue lapis flecked with pyrite, spaced with icy clear quartz and gold-filled beads. Worn for mental sharpness, honest speech and seeing what is actually there.
affirmation: I see clearly and I speak the truth.
